india.one_line: India sees new AI data framework and major startup funding.

themes.title: MeitY issues DEPA handbook
themes.text: The Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology released a handbook on the Data Empowerment and Protection Architecture, outlining a techno‑legal framework that enables institutions to share data for AI training while retaining control through contractual permissions, clean rooms and privacy safeguards.

stories.headline: MeitY releases DEPA handbook to enable trusted data sharing for AI training

themes.title: CapGrid raises ₹50 cr for drones
themes.text: CapGrid secured ₹50 cr in a pre‑Series B round led by Hero Enterprise Venture Partners, valuing the startup at ₹430 cr, to fund R&D on precision components and expand into drone manufacturing and data‑centre markets.

stories.headline: CapGrid raises ₹50 cr funding, valued at ₹430 cr to expand into drones and data centres
